a sociable driving agent is an effective means for maintaining the drivers' situation awareness during autonomous driving, and the effectiveness is enhanced by the eye-gaze behaviors of the driving agents.
NAMIDA with or without eye-gaze behavior is effective in reducing the driver's response time, and the driver's subjective impression is higher for NAMIDA when it includes eye-gaze behavior.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
NAMIDA is effective in maintaining the drivers' situation awareness during autonomous driving.
a sociable driving agent with eye-gaze behavior can effectively keep the driver's attention to the road.

NAMIDA with gaze behaviors is more effective than NAMIDA without gaze behaviors in maintaining the driver's situation-awareness, while NAMIDA without behaviors is more effective in reducing response time.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the drivers' attention could be kept active during autonomous driving with the help of sociable driving agents.
the existence of NAMIDAs is more important than their social behaviors to maintain driver's situation awareness.
NAMIDA is a promising interface to maintain driver's situation-awareness and keep their attention to the road during autonomous driving.
